{"caption":"Workflow diagram showing how an agent explores a sandbox, synthesizes candidate tasks, and replays them to check feasibility.","description":"The diagram has three numbered stages connected from left to right. At the top, an agent is beside a speech bubble reading “I have a sandbox environment. There are locations and facilities on map...” Below it are the blue labels “Environment Profile” and “User Preference.” A gray right-pointing arrow labeled “Self-Questioning” leads to a dashed box containing two visible green “Query” cards and two “Ref. Solution” cards, followed by an ellipsis to indicate more pairs.

① “Exploration”: A small agent walks beside a circular street map containing several blue facility/building symbols, a waypoint marker, and a house. An orange route crosses the map from the agent and exits to the right, with an arrow pointing toward the next stage. The panel is labeled “Walk in Environment.”

② “Task Synthesis”: A dashed “Agent Trajectory” box contains a short numbered sequence of alternating blue “Action” and gray “Observation” bars. A dashed “User Pref.” box lists “Difficulty,” “Style,” and “Rubrics,” each with a small illustrative icon. Orange curved, dashed connectors from the trajectory and preferences converge toward the task-generation area. Beside a small agent, the prompt reads “What potential problems can this solve?” A black question-mark badge marks the generated query, shown as “Plan path to go back home ?”; a second orange card below is labeled “Ref. Solution” and has a map/route icon. An orange arrow points right from these generated items into the curation stage.

③ “Task Curation”: Two filter boxes read “+ Duplication Filter” and “+ User-Defined Filter.” A small replaying agent at the lower left is connected by a dotted blue winding path to an agent at the upper left of a circular street map. The map shows a waypoint and blue facility symbols; an orange route runs from the map-side agent, past the waypoint, toward the house at the right. The panel is labeled “Try Replaying.” At the right, “Query & Solution are feasible” appears beside an agent with a green checked box; green query and reference-solution icons are shown alongside. The arrows and paths depict exploration feeding task synthesis, then replay and feasibility checking.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
